name: tasklist
description: Live task state for a run, in which a task cannot be marked done without an observed successful tool call.
author: Adaptive Agent Harness

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Create or update a task. Status is one of pending, in_progress, done, blocked. A task cannot be marked done unless a successful call to a real tool has been observed since it entered in_progress: an unevidenced done is refused and says what is missing. A task that is done or blocked does not silently go back to pending. Use this to hold a plan the run is actually keeping.

id.description: Stable identifier for the task, e.g. 'fix-null-deref'.

note.description: What happened, or why a blocked task is being re-opened.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: List the tasks being tracked, optionally filtered to one status. Shows how many observed tool calls each in_progress or done task has.

status.description: pending, in_progress, done or blocked. Empty for all.

tools.name: task_clear
tools.description: Reset the task list and all recorded evidence. Use at the start of a new run.
